head: ¡Hola Ola! teaches the Spanish you need on a beach trip
dek: ¡Hola Ola! teaches travel Spanish for coastal trips: hailing a taxi, checking into a hostel, ordering dinner, making friends and renting a surfboard. It was #60 among paid Travel apps on the US App Store on 7 November.
details: It came out on 5 November and costs $1.99, by Casey William Ferguson.
means: If you're heading to a Spanish-speaking coast, you learn the phrases you'll actually use.
todo: Find ¡Hola Ola! in the App Store.
